functions.name: Lex_RunParser
functions.evidence: Resets lexer counters, installs a stack-allocated yy_buffer_state (ch_buf = g_lex_char_buf, size 0x4000, not heap-owned), starts in start-condition 3, runs the parser fn_08085932 and returns its result in *out_result. Descriptive name. The stack buffer stays referenced by the buffer stack after return (as in the original).

functions.evidence: Kicks one client (strings 'EXE_PLAYERKICKED', 'EXE_CANNOTKICKHOSTPLAYER'); optionally copies the cleaned name to out_name. Returns the client's field at +0xae704 (0 when the host/loopback client refuses the kick).

%s all = kick everyone
